# **English Description**
OptiCore Matrix is a tailor-made modpack for explorers seeking to enhance their vanilla Minecraft experience. Blending optimization/utility/tech mods, it achieves a balanced fusion of performance and vanilla enhancement through modular configuration. From Sodium’s performance tuning to Inventory HUD+’s player inventory streamlining, and from Tweakeroo’s precision utilities to Smooth Scrollin’s buttery-smooth transitions—every mod has undergone rigorous stress testing (tested on specs: i5-7500, GTX 1050 Ti) to ensure stability across complex mod ecosystems. Whether you’re tackling massive redstone projects or chasing an ultra-vanilla lightweight experience, this pack delivers consistent optimization. I recommend using it on vanilla servers if you plan to run shaders.If you're looking for simpler optimization, I'd recommend choosing[Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)
## **中文描述**
OptiCore Matrix 是为追求强化原版游戏体验的探险家量身定制的模组包，融合了优化、辅助与生电模组，通过模块化配置实现了性能与原版增强的平衡。从 Sodium 的性能优化到 Inventory HUD+ 的玩家物品栏优化，从 Tweakeroo 的精准辅助功能到 Smooth Scrollin 的丝滑滚动体验——每个模组都经过了严格的压力测试（测试配置：i5-7500，GTX 1050 Ti），确保了在复杂模组生态下的稳定运行。无论是应对大型红石工程，还是追求极致轻量化的原版游戏体验，这个整合包都能提供稳定的优化效果。如果你打算开启光影，我建议在原生服务器上使用此整合包。我也建议外置账号玩家考虑使用。在游玩插件服或原生服务器时，我已添加 Offlineskin；正版玩家？那这本身就是一个很好的优化包。
如果你追求更简单的性能优化，我推荐选择[简单优化](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)
